title: Elodie and the Confession
author: Noor Joubert
blurb: Coral Almeida, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
